title: React v2 Cinema Mode: replace hardcoded EVENT_STREAM with real run data — hosts as 3D nodes, live task stdout, local fonts
goal: Update ui-v2/src/components/CinemaMode.tsx to use real data from the Zustand store + API. REQUIRES backlog-268 and 269. (1) REAL NODE DATA: Instead of hardcoded TARGETS array, read discovered hosts from the inventory snapshot: use selectedRunInventory from Zustand store. Each host in normalized_inventory_json.hosts becomes a node. Node color: red for hosts with critical findings, amber for high findings, cyan for discovered only. If no inventory: show the existing empty node as a 'waiting for discovery' fallback. Node positions are deterministic based on host index so they don't jump on re-render (use seeded pseudo-random position from hostname hash). (2) REAL EVENT STREAM: Instead of hardcoded EVENT_STREAM, poll GET /api/v1/runs/{runId}/tasks every 4 seconds. For each running or recently completed task: extract the last 2 lines from task.executions[last].stdout_text. Build the event as { tool: task.tool.toUpperCase(), target: task.target_id, msg: lastStdoutLine }. Only emit events when stdout actually changes (compare with previous). Limit displayed log to last 10 events. Show real tool names (NMAP, HTTPX, NUCLEI, ZAP, etc.). (3) LOCAL FONTS: The 3D Text components use a Google Fonts URL for Fira Mono. Download the Fira Mono woff2 file and place it at ui-v2/public/fonts/FiraMono.woff2. Update the font prop in all Text components to '/fonts/FiraMono.woff2'. This ensures Cinema Mode works offline and in airgapped deployments. (4) BOTTOM HUD: Make the bottom-left HUD data real — ACTIVE.TOOL shows the actual running task tool, TARGET shows actual task.target_id. (5) CAMERA FLIGHT: The camera currently lerps to the activeIndex node. Make this follow the actual active task's target: find the node index whose hostname/IP matches activeEvent.target. If no match: orbit slowly around the center. (6) STATS OVERLAY: Add a bottom-right overlay showing 4 counters (matching the existing Cinema Mode stats): Critical findings count, High findings count, Hosts discovered count, AI Proposals pending count — all from the Zustand store, updating in real time.
scope: Cinema Mode already has excellent 3D visualization. This task makes it show real data instead of mock data and fixes the font dependency.
generation_reason: Cinema Mode 3D is the best feature in ui-v2. It must use real data to be useful in production.

inputs.prerequisite_backlog: REQUIRES: backlog-268 and backlog-269 completed first.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.

success_criteria: 3D nodes come from real inventory hosts, not hardcoded TARGETS.
Event stream shows real task stdout from polling API.
Fira Mono font loaded from /fonts/FiraMono.woff2 (local file).
Bottom HUD shows real tool and target names.
Camera follows actual running task's target node.
Stats overlay shows real critical/high/hosts/proposals counts.
Cinema Mode works when offline (no external font URLs).

acceptance_criteria: Cinema Mode opens with real nodes.
